subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: What should OpenClaw's permanent dynamic model discovery contract be for OpenRouter and gateway-style providers?
rationale: The answer affects plugin API shape, provider routing, configured allowlists, cache/offline policy, endpoint trust, and model-picker defaults, so code inspection cannot safely choose it automatically.

options.title: Provider-owned live catalogs
options.body: Use guarded provider/plugin live catalog hooks per provider, with explicit wildcard, cache, fallback, and picker rules that build on current infrastructure.

options.title: Generated catalog refresh
options.body: Add a command or config-driven refresh that writes local catalog rows, trading better offline behavior for migration and SecretRef-safe write-policy work.

options.title: Runtime fallback only
options.body: Continue synthesizing unknown models at execution time and accept incomplete model-list and picker discovery for fast-moving catalogs.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned live catalogs
recommendation.body: Use guarded provider/plugin live catalog hooks per provider, with explicit wildcard, cache, fallback, and picker rules that build on current infrastructure.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to joshp123 and the unresolved decision is product/API direction for the issue they opened.
